title: Motion-Picture Film (8-mm Type S) - Magnetic Audio Record - Position, Dimensions and Reproducing Speed
scope: 1.1 This standard specifies the position, dimensions, and reproducing speed of the magnetic audio record on 8-mm type S motion-picture film having a nominal 0.027-in (0.69-mm) width magnetic stripe. 1.2 This standard also specifies the longitudinal picture-audio displacement on the film.
